title: Feature-gate deps that default builds pull in unused
description:
A default `cargo build --workspace` reports two unconditional dependencies
that nothing in the default build uses:

  pkix-ct/Cargo.toml:42            unused dependency `pkix-path`
  pkix-revocation-http/Cargo.toml:48  unused dependency `pkix-revocation`

In pkix-ct the uses of `pkix_path::SignatureVerifier` /
`pkix_path::encode_tbs_certificate` all live in `src/verify.rs` and
`src/log_list.rs`, and both modules are `#[cfg(feature = "log-list")]`.
So a consumer who takes pkix-ct with default features compiles pkix-path
and its signature backends for nothing. pkix-revocation-http looks like
the same shape; confirm before changing it.

The fix is `optional = true` on the dependency plus `dep:` in the feature
that actually needs it. That is additive for anyone already enabling the
feature, and it removes build weight for everyone else.

Found while publishing pkix-ct 0.2.2: `cargo publish` runs its
verification build with default features, which is why the warning
surfaces there and not in CI's --all-features gate. Deliberately NOT
folded into that release — it changes the feature graph, and the release
was scoped to version bumps.
